notes: Run of 2026-11-11. Two SFist stories read: the SFMade opening earns an entry; the Muni shooting names no address.

findings.description: SFMade, a nonprofit for local manufacturing, opened its first permanent store on Tuesday 10 November at 373 Geary Street, on the ground floor of the Handlery Hotel, selling work by more than 100 Bay Area makers. SF Standard covers the same opening and is declined as the duplicate.

citation.label: SFist, “SFMade Opens Permanent Union Square Store Showcasing Over 100 Local Makers,” 10 November 2026
